genericNonzeroControl.method: Smooth compact f and a normalized co-moving cosine. Perturb W_rz by Z^4 (T-T0)/24 times (ci/epsilon^2) Dr(R^-1 Dr(R^2 f)) N(h). Exact translated FTC at both primitives gives delta psi_ZZT=R f h. The printed finite polynomial example is only a check of the signed rational factors.

exactTemporalPressureFrontier.reason: The surviving beta_Temporal,ZT*gamma term has psi_Temporal,ZZT, hence the twice differentiated axial W_rz pressure density. No separate P_ZT or Jz_ZT occurs for FiveMap first T. The L2 companion comes from the selected Fourier estimate.

freshMoments.gamma_ZTTransfer: Using eps gamma_Temporal,ZT=-D1 beta_Temporal,T, move D1 onto R^w times the factor using normalized periodic Haar. The boundary is -[R^w Haar(f beta_Temporal,T)]/eps and vanishes on both original flat traces. For Jtheta the factor is V+v; for the mixed pressure flux it is b+beta. The initialized gamma_ZT is retained explicitly.
freshMoments.zeroTemporalLinear: Haar of the centered inverse and its shifted T1 is zero, including ordinary derivatives. Accordingly -time(beta_Temporal) and epsilon lapVector(beta_Temporal) contribute zero.

normalizedFixedLabelT.gamma: partial_T of two actual Jtheta-dependent bump copies
normalizedFixedLabelT.physicalTimeUnit: original normalized derivative preserves the fixed reference-to-own b^(-A-1) factor
normalizedFixedLabelT.v: partial_T of three actual P,Jz-dependent bump copies

scope: Protected identities and a sufficient pinned source request set. Requires smooth admitted original chart and flat guards, quantitative v_ZT and beta_ZT bounds, positive original matrix factors and their differentiated coefficient geometry for any new whole-velocity norm.

wholeAxialCancellation.support: Original positive bump copies satisfy Xa < X0Imean < X < exp(2)X0Imean < Xb and 1/2 <= s <= 2, hence remain strictly inside both fixed radial ends. Shape cutoffs are flat before extending zero.
